# MediEval

> Human evaluation cards, reviewer judgments, corrections, optional calibration, team agreement, and auditable label exports.

Documentation describes the source checkout, not guaranteed deployment availability. Detect account-platform versus shared-token mode before using an API. Quality policy and expert designation are batch scoped. Exported labels alone do not establish quality.

## Start

- [Documentation hub](docs/README.md): human guide and service-mode selection.
- [Agent guide](docs/AGENTS.md): identity, authorization, retries, conflicts, and completion checks.
- [Machine manifest](docs/agent/manifest.json): versioned inventory and implementation scope.
- [Workflows](docs/agent/workflows.json): prerequisites, ordered operation IDs, side effects, verification, and stop conditions.
- [API catalog](docs/agent/api.json): paths, auth contexts, requests, response fields, and retry semantics.
- [JSON Schemas](docs/agent/schemas.json): recommended client payload contracts.
- [Examples](docs/agent/examples.json): synthetic records, cards, results, references, and configuration.

When served by the application, relative links above resolve through its documentation routes. `/llms-full.txt` returns all product guides in one response. Public documentation never includes customer data, session tokens, or reference answers.
